messages:
mira: quick question about the slab-lease sampler from yesterday's RFC follow-up. Do we have concerns about sampler overhead on hot paths?
sam: good catch. plan is to make sampler async and probabilistic. hot alloc path only bumps a per-core counter (cheap). sampler reads counters off-thread.
oliver: how often does sampler run? too frequent = cpu waste, too rare = stale compaction decisions.
sam: prototype: sample every 200ms with 1% probability per slab; tune from perf runs.
mira: eviction semantics? if sampler marks slab compactable, do we immediately demote pages to host or wait for lease expiry?
oliver: prefer demote->async move, not immediate free. preserves tail latency. reclaimed free happens after demote completes or TTL.
mira: telemetry we need: demote bytes/sec, sampler-run-latency, percent-stale-decisions (measureable by comparing sampler state vs real refcounts).
sam: agreed. also add per-tenant credit metering so noisy tenants don't game renew fastpath.
infra-bot: deployment: slab-lease-sampler branch -> perf-cluster at 01:00 UTC. smoke tests queued.
infra-bot: smoke tests: PASS.
mira: thanks, i'll run the microbench (small 1-8KB bursts) and post results here. :rocket:
